KNN → KFN Sweep — Samusik_01

Two views of the same 10,000-cell Samusik_01 UMAP (mouse bone marrow, 39 surface markers). Click any cell to start its animation. A window of neighbor ranks slides outward — ranks [1–100], then [51–150], [101–200], … out to the farthest neighbors.
  • Left — the window over neighbors ranked in UMAP (2-D) space.
  • Right — the window over neighbors ranked in the original high-dimensional marker space, drawn on the same UMAP.
Early frames are the k-nearest neighbors; late frames are the k-farthest. The right panel shows how well — or how poorly — the UMAP preserves the true high-dimensional neighborhood as the window moves from near to far. Agreement = the percent of cells shared by the left and right windows at the current rank band. Everything runs in your browser; no data is uploaded.
